name: GD AI Assistant
description: Natural-language level editing in the GD editor, powered by a local LLM sidecar.

sidecar-url.name: Sidecar WebSocket URL
sidecar-url.description: WebSocket URL of the local sidecar. Must be a loopback address.

auto-connect.name: Auto-connect on editor open
auto-connect.description: Connect to the sidecar automatically when entering the editor, and reconnect with backoff if the connection drops.

toggle-chat.name: Toggle chat panel
toggle-chat.description: Show or hide the assistant panel in the level editor.

max-message-length.name: Maximum message length
max-message-length.description: Maximum character count for a single user message.

frame-budget-ms.name: Per-frame edit budget (ms)
frame-budget-ms.description: Maximum main-thread time per frame spent applying assistant edits.

max-objects-per-request.name: Max objects per request
max-objects-per-request.description: Upper bound on objects created, modified, or deleted by a single request.
